verbal_intervention.headline: Trump-Warsh collision sharpened post-CPI: hike odds 85-90% vs president demanding cuts; WSJ - Trump has called Warsh repeatedly since he became chair; CNN carried - threatens to cease trading with top partners unless Fed lowers rates
verbal_intervention.source: CNN (Sep 4, carried) / WSJ exclusive (Sep 5-6 vintage, carried) / CNBC (Sep 5) / Reuters Dolan commentary (Sep 8) / Mint explainer - carried, escalated by CPI outcome
verbal_intervention.summary: The Fed-independence collision moved from threat to decision-point: markets now price an 85-90% HIKE at FOMC Sep 15-16 (t-3) while the president demands cuts, has phoned the chair repeatedly since appointment, and has threatened to cease trading with top partners unless rates fall. A hike over the president's objection puts independence stress inside an already-burning bond market; a fold risks unanchoring expectations. Warsh's first big test lands Wednesday.

verbal_intervention.headline: Iran vows response to US tanker strikes: American facilities 'exposed' - vow now fully overtaken by kinetic execution (Jordan + Bahrain base damage confirmed, biggest tanker wave of the war)
verbal_intervention.source: Christian Science Monitor (Sep 7) - carried, rhetoric fully converted to action in double window
verbal_intervention.summary: Iran's retaliation vow (US facilities and energy firms 'exposed') has been executed far beyond rhetoric: ballistic strikes on Jordan-hosted US forces, heavy damage confirmed by a US official on the Bahrain naval base near Manama, and the largest tanker-attack wave since the war began. Coercion signaling is now the operating regime - further vows should be priced as pre-announcements.

verbal_intervention.headline: Record $99bn yen intervention confirmed, funded by selling US Treasuries (~70% of reserves in USTs); August reserves largest-ever drop; NEW: reserves fell BELOW $1 TRILLION for first time in recent memory
verbal_intervention.source: Bloomberg via Japan Times (Sep 7) / Reuters / Wolf Street (Sep 7-8) / CryptoBriefing (sub-$1T threshold) - carried, threshold rung NEW
verbal_intervention.summary: Japan's record yen intervention ($99bn) is confirmed as partially UST-funded; August reserves posted the largest-ever drop (~$95bn FX component) and total reserves crossed below the $1 trillion line for the first time in recent memory. Official-sector UST selling is now a structural channel feeding US bond stress while the wildfire burns - and the intervention war-chest question is formally live.

verbal_intervention.headline: Bessent met Ueda and Katayama at G20, publicly pushed BOJ hikes; hike now near-certain for Sep 17-18 - external pressure converted into scheduled action
verbal_intervention.source: NHK via investinglive (Sep 9) - carried, converted (hike now sources-confirmed for next week)
verbal_intervention.summary: US Treasury Secretary publicly pressed BOJ hikes at the G20; within the double window the hike became near-certain (sources: 1.25% at Sep 17-18). Extraordinary external pressure on an independent central bank converted into a scheduled policy action - the yen-upside and carry-unwind implications are now dated events, not contingencies.

anonymous_leaks.headline: RBI intervention streak extends - now ON RECORD: governor tells CNBC-TV18 bond sales + FX swaps are among options to drain liquidity; rupee record-low regime deepens to 95.79-95.80 on oil spike
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters (Sep 7 $8bn bankers-say; Sep 8 streak extension traders-say; Sep 9 steps-in traders-say; Sep 10 FX-swaps mop-up; Sep 11 governor CNBC-TV18 on record) - carried, elevated to on-record
anonymous_leaks.summary: The trader-sourced streak reporting graduated to an on-record governor interview: bond sales and FX swaps named explicitly as liquidity tools while the rupee slid from 92.33 (prior cycle) into the 95.79-95.80 record-low regime. Reserve-drain defense of EM Asia's largest current-account-deficit currency is now declared policy posture, not inference - the oil bill is being financed from reserves.

anonymous_leaks.headline: Traders-say: BOJ set to lift rates next week but offer few clues on terminal rate - sources say Sep 17-18 hike to 1.25% locked, guidance deliberately opaque
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters (Sep 11, sources say) / Business Times carry
anonymous_leaks.summary: Anonymous BOJ-sourced reporting confirms the hike is locked for Sep 17-18 with the committee planning minimal terminal-rate guidance - a deliberate opacity play one week after the Fed decides and with the yen at 7-month highs. Anonymous-sourced scheduling of an independent bank's action days after a foreign government publicly pushed it is itself a sovereignty-stress marker.

central_bank_communication.headline: MAJOR: US CPI Fri Sep 11 core +0.3% m/m HOT (0.2% exp) after PPI 5.4% YoY Thu - Fed hike odds ~85-90% (from ~58-60%); FOMC Sep 15-16 hike = base case, t-3 days
central_bank_communication.source: Motley Fool (Sep 11, 85%) / NewsDive (~90%) / MishTalk (Sep 11, 85%) / AInvest (90% positioning-trade analysis) / breaking scanner 16:46Z corroboration
central_bank_communication.summary: CPI Friday delivered the hot print the prior cycle flagged: core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected, stacking on Thursday's 5.4% YoY PPI. Market-implied September hike odds jumped from ~58-60% to ~85-90% - one analysis argues the repricing is a positioning trade, not an inflation alarm, but the FOMC Sep 15-16 decision is now a hike base case three days out. A hike into a global bond rout with presidential opposition is the collision scenario.

central_bank_communication.headline: EXECUTED: ECB raised all three key rates Sep 10 - deposit to 2.50% (second hike) 'as Iran war drives inflation'; European bond selloff DEEPENED post-decision; traders brace for a NEW ECB hiking cycle
central_bank_communication.source: ECB press release (Sep 10) / Guardian (Sep 10) / Bloomberg (Sep 10) / Reuters (Sep 10, multi-year-high yields, new-hike-cycle pricing) / WSJ live (selloff deepened)
central_bank_communication.summary: The ECB executed the 25bp hike to 2.50% and explicitly framed it as war-inflation insurance - Lagarde warned the Iran war is fuelling inflation. Instead of settling the market it deepened the selloff: yields hit multi-year highs and traders began pricing a NEW hiking cycle, with the German Bund at its highest since 2011 (~3.50%). Hiking into a supply-shock bond rout without a fragmentation backstop is the exact pick-your-poison risk flagged pre-decision.

central_bank_communication.headline: BOJ hike to 1.25% at Sep 17-18 near-certain (sources); Reuters - terminal 1.75% to be reached FASTER than expected; yen 7-month-high regime; JGB 2.973 settled
central_bank_communication.source: Reuters sources (Sep 11) / Japan Times/AFP-JIJI (Sep 12) / Reuters analysis (Sep 9) / breaking scanner JGB settles
central_bank_communication.summary: The BOJ decision is now a dated near-certainty: policy rate to 1.25% at Sep 17-18 with Reuters-sourced reporting that the terminal path to 1.75% will be traversed faster than markets expected. JGB 10Y settled 2.973 (52-week high 3.023 intact) with the yen holding its 7-month-high regime - the carry-unwind and repatriation channel activates on a date, six days out, one week after the Fed.

central_bank_communication.headline: PBOC resists yuan appreciation: weaker-than-expected fixings, dovish tone; yuan ~32-month high as export squeeze persists
central_bank_communication.source: Bloomberg (Aug 20 vintage, carried) / Reuters (Aug 31) - no fresh in-window print
central_bank_communication.summary: PBOC keeps using the daily fixing to slow yuan gains while domestic demand stays weak - appreciation resistance amid an export-led growth model. Carried standing; no fresh fixing news in the double window.

central_bank_communication.headline: China recap skepticism standing + FRESH skepticism rung: Reuters explainer 'why now?' (Sep 11); Desmond Shum - 'China Cannot Recapitalise Demand' (RMB 360bn via 8 institutions); credit demand stays weak
central_bank_communication.source: CNBC (Sep 7) / Caixin (Sep 7, $45bn/300bn yuan explainer) / Reuters explainer (Sep 11) / Desmond Shum Substack (Sep 7)
central_bank_communication.summary: The biggest recapitalization in two decades (300bn yuan into banks AND first-ever state-insurer recap) continues to draw structural skepticism: Reuters dedicated an explainer to 'why now?', and Desmond Shum argues the injection cannot recapitalise demand itself - 8 central-government institutions raising ~RMB 360bn patches solvency while private credit demand stays weak. Transmission failure persists alongside the patch.

central_bank_communication.headline: BOJ board member Masu: 'will continue to raise benchmark rate' + warns price risks may FORCE RAPID hikes - hawkish escalation 7 days before Sep 17-18
central_bank_communication.summary: BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu went beyond his prior 'will continue raising' line: price risks may trigger RAPID rate hikes if inflation accelerates - a board-level warning of non-gradualism into a yen-carry unwind with JGB yields at multi-decade highs. Escalates the pace-risk tail of the Sep 17-18 decision.

geopolitical_posture.headline: ESCALATED: Iran missile damage on US bases CONFIRMED - Bahrain naval base near Manama 'blew the hell out of it' (US official, heavy damage, F-15E/A-10 mentioned) + Jordan airbase strike sustained; first-cycle direct strikes on US forces on third-country soil now a confirmed damage regime
geopolitical_posture.source: Al Jazeera (Sep 11, US official on Bahrain) / Petra (Sep 9, Jordan) - carried + escalated
geopolitical_posture.summary: The Jordan strike (Sep 9, ~20 ballistic missiles, 18 intercepted) is now joined by US-official-confirmed HEAVY damage to the Bahrain naval base near Manama - 'blew the hell out of it'. Two third-country host bases damaged by direct Iranian fire inside one week converts base-strike from escalation rung to operating regime; US retaliation doctrine is the open variable.

geopolitical_posture.headline: ESCALATED: Iran and US hit tankers in BIGGEST wave of attacks on shipping since war began (Reuters); Iran hit US sea drone in Hormuz Strait; US blockade diverts 96 vessels
geopolitical_posture.summary: The tanker war institutionalized at maximum tempo: the biggest attack wave on shipping since the war began, with both belligerents striking tankers, an Iranian hit on a US sea drone inside the Strait, and the US blockade diverting 96 vessels. Strike-cycle shortening continues; each wave raises the bar for the next.

geopolitical_posture.headline: Iran restricted-zone declaration STILL pending - coordinates unissued beyond 'coming days' (day 8+); zone scope already EXPANDED to Gulf of Oman + Arabian Sea; entrants face sanctions list
geopolitical_posture.source: Al-Monitor / Anadolu / Baird Maritime (Rezaei, SNSC) - carried, pending
geopolitical_posture.summary: The declared restricted maritime zone's coordinate maps remain unissued despite the scope expansion to Gulf of Oman + Arabian Sea. A standing, undischarged escalation commitment: when maps land, vessels entering the zone join a sanctions list - a self-executing trigger the market has not priced as active.

geopolitical_posture.headline: NEW MAJOR: Saudi East-West Pipeline (Petroline, 1,200km, 4-5M bpd = 4-5% of GLOBAL supply) SHUT 'as a precaution' after drone attack in Riyadh + Medina regions - attack ORIGINATED IN IRAQ per Baghdad and Riyadh (Iranian-backed militias); Iraq dismissed Maysan commander + closed Shalamcheh crossing; Saudi holds retaliation at Iraqi PM's request
geopolitical_posture.source: The Hindu/AP first wire (~20:34Z Sep 11) / Reuters + Straits Times (Sep 12 01:06Z) / Gulf News (Sep 12) / CNN (Sep 11, fires) / Al-Monitor (Sep 11)
geopolitical_posture.summary: The war reached inside Saudi production infrastructure via a THIRD-COUNTRY vector: the Petroline east-west crude artery (4-5% of global supply capacity) is shut, the attack is attributed by both capitals to Iranian-backed militias operating from Iraq, and Iraq pre-emptively punished its own commander and sealed the Shalamcheh crossing. Riyadh has NOT retaliated - at the Iraqi PM's request - holding a deferred-escalation trigger. Saudi crude exports lowest in over three decades (IEA).

geopolitical_posture.headline: NEW MAJOR: Houthi FULL Red Sea coast consolidation - Mocha port captured (Sep 10), Perim/Mayyun island seized (Sep 11), 'entire western coast' controlled (AFP/Xinhua); MBS called Trump AT LEAST TWICE for direct US military action - DECLINED so far (intel + targeting only); selective blockade: 'navigation safe for all except Saudi vessels'
geopolitical_posture.source: Reuters first wire (Sep 11 09:47Z Perim) / BBC (Sep 11-12) / Xinhua (Sep 12 00:47Z) / AFP (Sep 12) / CBS (2 sources, MBS-Trump) / Reuters (2 Iranian sources: Iran ordered Houthi escalation + promised funding/weapons/officers)
geopolitical_posture.summary: The Houthis completed coastal control of the entire Yemeni Red Sea littoral in the double window - port city (Mocha) plus the strategic island (Perim) that anchors Bab el-Mandeb - and Iran has ordered further escalation with promised funding, weapons and officers. MBS personally requested direct US military action at least twice; Washington declined so far. The selective blockade ('safe except Saudi vessels') formalizes economic warfare against one state while claiming legality for all others.

geopolitical_posture.headline: DE-ESCALATION WATCH: Iran-GCC-Iraq meet MONDAY in Oman (scheduled catalyst); Araghchi - 'diplomacy back on track isn't impossible'; AP - US made progress reopening Hormuz but war far from over
geopolitical_posture.source: Al Jazeera / AAWSat / World Oil (Sep 11) / AP via KRMG (Sep 11)
geopolitical_posture.summary: A scheduled Monday diplomatic track (Iran-GCC-Iraq, Oman) plus measured US progress on Hormuz reopening constitutes the first standing de-escalation vector of the war phase - watch-only, not a tick: the same window produced the Petroline shutdown and coastal consolidation. Monday's meeting is the dated catalyst to score.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: ESCALATED: Brent ABOVE $100 the entire window - first settle over $100 of conflict phase (101.68 Sep 9) -> +6% surge with WTI also >$100 (Sep 10) -> weekend settle 104.61 (>$100 ~68h); US diesel record; IEA cuts 2026 demand to -2.5M bpd + supply loss -5.7M bpd
supply_chain_disruption.source: Reuters (Sep 9 + Sep 10) / The National (Sep 11, week above $100) / IEA Sep OMR via breaking scanner / Newsquawk settle verification
supply_chain_disruption.summary: Oil closed the week above $100 for the first time since mid-May and held it through the weekend (Brent 104.61, >$100 for ~68 hours by Sunday pre-dawn). US diesel at record levels; the IEA cut 2026 demand to -2.5M bpd with supply losses -5.7M bpd and delayed recovery into next year. The energy shock is now a full trading week old and hardening, not fading.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: NEW: Petroline shutdown supply leg - 4-5M bpd east-west crude artery offline (4-5% of global supply) + Saudi crude exports lowest in >3 DECADES (IEA Friday); Red Sea alternative under Houthi coastal control
supply_chain_disruption.source: Reuters / Straits Times / Gulf News (Sep 12) / The National / Forbes Middle East (Sep 11) / IEA via breaking scanner
supply_chain_disruption.summary: The pipeline shut 'as a precaution' removes 4-5M bpd of eastward-crude flexibility while Saudi exports sit at three-decade lows. The redundancy map is hostile: the western alternative (Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb) is under Houthi coastal control with war-risk premiums surging, and the Hormuz corridor is blockade-constrained. Global supply redundancy is now structurally impaired on both routes.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: NEW: Bab el-Mandeb traffic falls sharply to ~26 vessels/day (2nd major deterioration) + Houthi blockade on Saudi ships keeps traffic -15%; war-risk premiums + freight surging as coastal control prices in; container market diverting around Cape of Good Hope
supply_chain_disruption.source: Anadolu (Sep 11) / SupplyStatus / AInvest (Sep 10-11, war-risk premium + tanker repricing analyses) / AGBI (Sep 9) / CNN Business (Sep 11, 'lifeline in jeopardy')
supply_chain_disruption.summary: Commercial transit through Bab el-Mandeb fell to ~26 vessels/day - the second major deterioration since the Gaza war - while Houthi coastal control converts directly into war-risk premiums and freight repricing ('the tankers have already priced it'; Saudi reroutes 75% of affected barrels). Container lines divert around the Cape of Good Hope, extending effective supply distances for Europe and Asia simultaneously.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: Hormuz blockade regime: US blockade diverts 96 vessels; Iran hits US sea drone in Strait; partial counter-tick - oil shipments through Hormuz RISE with US naval escort assistance
supply_chain_disruption.source: CGTN (Sep 11) / Stars and Stripes (Sep 11) / breaking scanner transit counts (7 vs 11)
supply_chain_disruption.summary: The Hormuz regime is blockade-management, not closure: 96 vessels diverted by the US blockade, an Iranian hit on a US sea drone in the Strait, while escorted oil shipments partially RISE under US naval assistance. Transit counts remain depressed (7 vs 11 baseline); the escorted-lane model holds the artery open at reduced throughput with constant skirmish risk.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: ESCALATED: European energy spillover hardens - TTF gas near EUR 80 / highest since 2022 with LNG squeezed by Hormuz disruption (Commerzbank via WSJ); Brent >$100 + TTF near EUR 80 set risk-off tone; Europe's worst bond selloff in years deepens post-ECB
supply_chain_disruption.source: CaixaBank Research daily (Sep 10) / XTB (Sep 9) / IndexBox (Sep 9) / WSJ-Commerzbank / Gate News (Sep 7) / Reuters (Sep 10)
supply_chain_disruption.summary: Europe's energy input hardened through the window: TTF near EUR 80/MWh (highest since 2022) as Hormuz disruption squeezes LNG supply into low-inventory winter, compounding Brent above $100. The combined shock set a persistent risk-off tone across European markets and directly feeds the sovereign-yield repricing (Bund highest since 2011) - energy-driven inflation meets a central bank that just hiked into it.

regulatory_change.headline: China recap formalization standing: 300bn yuan ($45bn) into banks + FIRST-EVER state-insurer recap; Reuters 'why now?' explainer; market skepticism (shares slid on announcement; analysts call for more)
regulatory_change.source: Caixin (Sep 7) / Insurance Business (Sep 8) / Reuters explainer (Sep 11) / CNBC (Sep 7)
regulatory_change.summary: The recapitalization leg is formalized and explained: first-ever government recapitalisation of state insurers inside the biggest (300bn yuan) bank+insurer injection in two decades. The transmission question - whether solvency patches reignite credit demand - remains unanswered; market skepticism is the standing verdict.

regulatory_change.headline: Iran restricted-zone sanctions-list mechanism standing: entrants face sanctions list when coordinates issue; scope expanded to Gulf of Oman + Arabian Sea; maps pending day 8+
regulatory_change.source: Al-Monitor / Anadolu / Baird Maritime (SNSC) - carried, pending
regulatory_change.summary: The self-executing escalation mechanism stands: once zone coordinates publish, vessels entering join an Iranian sanctions list. Scope has already expanded once (Gulf of Oman + Arabian Sea); the trigger remains undischarged and unpriced.

regulatory_change.headline: US bulk-power-system national emergency standing (Federal Register Aug 31, first-logged) - emergency authorities remain active into the energy shock
regulatory_change.summary: The national emergency declaration for the US bulk-power system remains on the books - standing regulatory authorities that pre-position federal power over grid inputs as the oil shock raises electricity and diesel costs (US diesel at record).

regulatory_change.headline: Canada retaliation / White House fact sheet trade-war leg standing (no fresh in-window rung; trade-weaponization threat carried under vi-001)
regulatory_change.source: White House fact sheet (Sep 9, pre-window) - carried
regulatory_change.summary: The Canada-retaliation rung and White House response stand carried with no fresh development in the double window; the Trump 'cease trading with top partners' threat (vi-001) keeps trade-policy weaponization live as a Fed-pressure instrument.

regulatory_change.headline: NEW: Iran DOUBLES gasoline price for heaviest consumers + deploys security forces (mounted machine gun, Khorramabad) - emergency war-economy rationing regime change; politically sensitive fuel repricing with strike follow-through
regulatory_change.source: Iran International (Sep 7 + Sep 8) / The Hill-AP / Seoul Economic Daily (Sep 12)
regulatory_change.summary: Iran executed a politically sensitive doubling of non-quota gasoline prices while deploying security forces preemptively - a war-economy rationing regime change under sanctions and blockade. The measure immediately produced driver strikes (su-001), confirming the home-front stress channel the prior cycle flagged as spreading protests.

regulatory_change.headline: China property-cooling leg standing: completed-home sales shift + land market cools (Caixin) - transmission failure persists alongside the recap patch
regulatory_change.summary: China's shift to completed-home sales and the cooling land market stand as the property-transmission-failure marker; the recap injection (rc-001) patches institutions, not demand. No fresh rung in-window.

social_unrest.headline: ESCALATED: Iran home-front - gasoline doubling produced queues across cities (DW), mounted machine-gun deployment (Khorramabad) and NEW taxi/truck DRIVER STRIKES ('drivers pay fuel costs out of pocket')
social_unrest.source: DW (Sep 1, carried) / Iran International (Sep 8) / Seoul Economic Daily (Sep 12, strikes) / prior-cycle protest-spread rungs
social_unrest.summary: Iran's war-economy fuel repricing converted protest risk into organized labor action: taxi and truck drivers strike over cost pass-through while queues persist and security forces deploy preemptively. Domestic stress inside a belligerent under blockade adds an internal-pressure vector to the war thread.

social_unrest.headline: ESCALATED: Gambia violent blackout protests - tyres burned (Reuters), tear gas deployed, Tanji police station ablaze, emergency State House meeting, president urges calm ('You're not alone in the darkness'); anger at breaking point months ahead of elections
social_unrest.summary: Gambia's power-crisis unrest escalated to violent protests with an ablaze police station and presidential calm-appeals - energy-poverty unrest in a small West African state with elections months away. Logged untagged: no macro-thread mapping (regional), but the energy-price-unrest pattern it exemplifies is the same channel as Iran's.

social_unrest.headline: Ebola outbreak stress sustained + numeric rungs: 7th province (Sud-Ubangi, FIRST in western Congo), deaths near 3,400 of >7,000 cases, Africa CDC 'spreading rapidly beyond its epicentre', 'too early to declare under control'
social_unrest.source: NBC News (Sep 11-12) / WHO DON617 (Sep 10) / WHO AFRO SitRep 17 (data Sep 6) / Xinhua / Africa CDC briefings / Health Policy Watch (Sep 3)
social_unrest.summary: The DRC/Uganda Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak posted fresh numeric rungs inside the window: a 7th affected province and the first in western Congo (a worrisome geographic spread), deaths approaching 3,400 of >7,000 cases, and Africa CDC warning the outbreak is spreading rapidly beyond its epicentre and is not yet under control. Regional-but-untamed; global-pandemic thread holds at DEVELOPING on the hand layer.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: ESCALATED: global bond rout - Europe's worst weekly selloff since March; Bund highest since 2011 (~3.50 post-ECB); US10Y 4.975 cusp (H 4.985); 30Y auction record-strong foreign demand YET yields still surged; Bessent $6bn buyback disappointed
financial_stress_precursors.source: Reuters (Sep 10, multi-year highs + new ECB cycle pricing) / Euronews (Sep 10, buyback) / Business Times (Sep 11) / ZeroHedge-StockScreener (Sep 10 21:08Z, record 30Y) / AInvest ('auction strong, system strained') / breaking scanner wires
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The bond wildfire burned hotter through the window: Europe's worst weekly selloff since March with the Bund at a since-2011 high after the ECB hike, US 10Y holding the 4.975 cusp. The 30Y auction drew record foreign demand yet yields still surged - absorption without price relief, the more bearish configuration - while the Treasury Secretary's $6bn buyback underwhelmed. Strong demand + rising yields = the system is strained, not starved.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: NEW MAIN-LINE: private credit defaults RISE as oil spike piles pressure on leveraged borrowers (CNBC main-line Sep 11); stress rises sharply among smallest borrowers (Houlihan Lokey data); spreads widen + non-accruals rise, market bifurcates
financial_stress_precursors.source: CNBC (Sep 11) / Alternative Credit Investor (Sep 11, Houlihan Lokey) / bond CAPITAL (Sep 8) / breaking scanner flagged-aggregator corroboration 16:46Z
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The private-credit stress channel graduated from aggregator-flagged to main-line CNBC: oil above $100 raises input-cost and inflation risks for leveraged borrowers already burdened by high debt costs, defaults are rising, smallest-borrower stress jumps sharply (Houlihan Lokey), and the market bifurcates with widening spreads and rising non-accruals. Shadow-bank stress as an energy-shock second-order effect is now observable, not hypothetical.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: ESCALATED: crypto liquidation cluster - PPI 5.4% YoY (Sep 10) flushed BTC below $77K ($562M liquidations, 'bond-market fire alarm' framing); post-CPI whipsaw $76K-$79K with $745M/24h liquidations; BTC ~77.3K weekend
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Crypto logged two liquidation waves inside the window - $562M on the hot PPI flush below $77K and $745M in 24h around CPI - versus $264M the prior cycle. Price whipsawed $76K-$79K and settled ~77.3K: elevated forced-flow activity versus the prior cycle's calm, still contained versus 2023-style deleveraging events, and analysis frames the move as leverage flush rather than structural break.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Gold safe-haven bid vs rising real yields - divergence rung: Gold 4,408.9 weekend (bounce from 4,390; cycle high 4,444.9; $4,500 untested) WHILE US10Y 4.975 and Bund 3.50
financial_stress_precursors.source: breaking scanner Yahoo live quotes (04:40Z) / threshold-scan gold RED wire standing (>$3,500, +25%+)
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Gold holds near 4,400 while real yields surge - a co-movement that normally excludes each other, signaling inflation-hedge and systemic-hedge demand absorbing the rate repricing. The $4,500 round-number test remains untaken; the gold-red wire (>$3,500) is sustained for the 12th+ cycle.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: ESCALATED: rupee record-low regime deepens 92.33 -> 95.79-95.80 through the double window; RBI $8bn+/week + FX-swap mop-up + governor on record (bond sales, FX swaps); EM Asia reserve-drain channel widens
financial_stress_precursors.source: Reuters (Sep 7/8/9/10/11 sequence) / FXStreet (Sep 10) / BigGo (Sep 11) / breaking scanner rupee reads
financial_stress_precursors.summary: India's defense of the rupee escalated from record-low 92.33 into the 95.80 regime across the window - a 3.5-handle depreciation with the central bank spending $8bn+/week plus FX swaps and now stating its toolset on record. Oil-bill financing via reserves is the transmission channel; won/peso standing stress keeps the divergence-not-contagion question open on the hand layer.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Standing credit-stress gauges: MOVE 74.68 (16th-17th identical check), BAA10Y 1.57 (FRED obs Sep 8); no new bank failures (FDIC 5 YTD); Brazil bank-fraud probe watch; SPX relief bounce +0.99% / VIX 15.84 post-CPI
financial_stress_precursors.source: threshold scanner checks (Sep 10-12) / FRED / FDIC via breaking scanner
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Volatility and credit-spread gauges stand elevated-but-static: MOVE pinned at 74.68 across 16-17 consecutive checks, BAA10Y 1.57 on the latest FRED observation. The equity complex bounced post-CPI (SPX +0.99%, VIX 15.84) - positioning relief inside a strained system, not calm. No new bank failures; private-credit leg (fs-002) is the live stress frontier.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: NEW THRESHOLD RUNG: Japan reserves fell BELOW $1 TRILLION for first time in recent memory after record intervention (~$96.5bn burned in August; ~$95bn FX-component drop; ~70% of reserves in USTs - structural UST-selling channel confirmed)
financial_stress_precursors.source: CryptoBriefing (sub-$1T) / CNBC ($80bn total drop) / Wolf Street ($95bn, interventions 'hugely profitable') / Bloomberg via Japan Times (Sep 7)
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Japan's intervention war-chest crossed a psychological floor: total reserves below $1 trillion for the first time in recent memory after burning ~$96.5bn in August, with the drop confirmed as partially UST-funded (~70% of reserves in Treasuries). The capacity question for future interventions is formally live - and each yen-defense sale feeds the US bond rout (fs-001).

financial_stress_precursors.headline: ESCALATED: euro financial-stress leg - sovereign yields 15-year highs -> Bund highest since 2011 (~3.50); TTF near EUR 80 into low-inventory winter; ECB hiked into the selloff without fragmentation backstop; France>Italy inversion standing
financial_stress_precursors.source: Reuters (Sep 10) / tradingeconomics (Sep 11) / XTB (Sep 9) / Gate News (Sep 7) / threshold scanner Bund 3.50 TE 20:35Z
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The euro area's financial-stress leg hardened: sovereign yields at 15-year highs with the Bund at its highest since 2011 after the ECB hiked into a supply-shock selloff with no fragmentation backstop announced. TTF near EUR 80 with winter inventories low keeps the energy-inflation input binding. France>Italy yield inversion stands as the periphery-spread watch marker.
